messages.subject: How can I change the background color by pressing an action button? (shinydashboard)
parts:
Hi,

how can I change the background color by pressing an action button?

I want theThe background color of my dashboardBody to change. 

Unfortunately, the dashboardBody has no attribute that I can manipulate via the server.R file. How would you do that?

I have isolated code for changing the background color. How can I call him with conditions?

tags$head(tags$style(HTML(' 
      .content-wrapper,
      .left-side {
      background-color: #123456;
      }'
)))




Thanks for your answers

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: How can I change the background color by pressing an action button? (shinydashboard)
parts:
Here's one way to do (assuming you only want this action to be taken up one time):

## app.R ##
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(),
  dashboardSidebar( actionButton("go", "Change color") ),
  dashboardBody()
)

server <- function(input, output) { 
  observeEvent(input$go, {
    insertUI("head", "beforeEnd", 
      tags$style(HTML('.content-wrapper, .left-side { background-color: #123456; }'))
    )
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE, once = TRUE)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
